01_main_menu_night: **Main menu over the live 3D stadium (Floodlit Night).** Glassmorphism KICK OFF tab with club and kit pickers, conditions, half length, difficulty and PLAY MATCH. Behind it: roof trusses, blooming floodlight banks, volumetric light shafts, the LED ribbon and the animated 3D crowd. FPS counter top right.
02_game_settings: **GAME SETTINGS.** Quality preset (Low · Medium · High · Ultra (MacBook Pro)), FPS target (30/60/120/Uncapped), render scale 50–150%, shadow map quality (Off/1024/2048/4096 px), anti-aliasing (Off/FXAA/MSAA 4x), floodlight bloom & volumetric lighting, 3D crowd density, turf detail, plus gameplay, camera and audio. All apply live.
03_controls: **CONTROLS.** The exact MacBook layout plus a live key tester (W, D and ↑ held here) and the Mission Control tip.
04_sunset: **Sunset.** Low warm sun from the physical sky, long shadows, floodlights switched on at reduced power, warm fog.
05_clear_day: **Clear Day.** Preetham physical sky, shadow-casting sun, daylight PMREM reflections; bloom is reduced so the stands stay crisp.
06_rain: **Rain.** Wind-blown rain streaks and splashes, wet glossy turf (lower roughness, darker albedo), thicker fog and light shafts through the downpour.
07_broadcast_kickoff: **Kick-off from the Broadcast gantry.** Minimalist top-left scorebug, toast prompt, translucent bottom-centre radar, mowing stripes, 3D lines, real-time floodlight shadows.
08_broadcast_play: **Open play.** The camera leads the ball with its velocity and tightens near the box (dynamic zoom).
09_power_bar: **Shot power.** Holding D fills the power arc on the ring at the player's feet; the readout bottom-left shows the charging action.
10_shot: **The strike.** Launch solved through the real ball physics (speed, topspin), then human error applied to the launch.
11_goal_celebration: **Goal!** The cloth net bulges and ripples, the scorer celebrates with arms raised, the crowd jumps, and the camera cuts to a low celebration shot.
12_pause_menu: **Esc pause menu.** RESUME, RESTART MATCH, QUIT TO MAIN MENU; the GAME SETTINGS and CONTROLS tabs stay available mid-match.
13_players_closeup: **Articulated players up close.** Sculpted capsule anatomy (V-shaped torso, tapered limbs), hair, ears, eyes, kits with shirt numbers, boots, the paneled ball, the at-feet ring, and LED sponsor boards behind.
